catalog.title: Slow Horses
catalog.description: A disgraced intelligence unit survives office politics and real operations.
catalog.insight: He hides disciplined tradecraft behind abrasive behavior and sees incentives his superiors miss.

catalog.title: The Americans
catalog.description: Two undercover officers juggle Cold War operations and a family they have built in America.
catalog.insight: The two officers share tradecraft but respond differently when their mission overlaps with parenthood and marriage.

catalog.title: The Bureau
catalog.description: French intelligence officers manage covers, assets, and personal loyalties.
catalog.insight: He is adept at living under cover. Emotional commitments make it harder to return to the boundaries his job requires.

catalog.title: The Day of the Jackal
catalog.description: A meticulous assassin and an intelligence officer become locked in a pursuit.
catalog.insight: A specialist and his pursuer run parallel professional lives and bring different reasons to accept the same costs.

catalog.title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
catalog.description: A retired intelligence officer must find a mole inside his own service.
catalog.insight: His restraint lets him notice contradictions that ambitious colleagues overlook. He treats loyalty as evidence to test.

catalog.title: A Most Wanted Man
catalog.description: An intelligence chief faces political pressure while investigating a man who arrives in Hamburg.
catalog.insight: He earns cooperation through patience and compromise. His leverage depends on agencies keeping their commitments.

catalog.title: The Lives of Others
catalog.description: A Stasi surveillance officer becomes drawn into the lives he monitors.
catalog.insight: A disciplined agent learns enough about his subjects to reconsider what loyalty requires.

catalog.title: A Spy Among Friends
catalog.description: The defection of Kim Philby forces his closest colleague to question their friendship.
catalog.insight: The two men read everyone around them while institutional trust and personal affection provide cover.

catalog.title: Three Days of the Condor
catalog.description: An analyst comes back to his office to find his colleagues dead.
catalog.insight: An analyst survives by reading incentives and motives with skills his organization values more in theory than in him.

catalog.title: Counterpart
catalog.description: A low-level employee learns what his agency guards and meets another version of himself.
catalog.insight: Two versions of one man have learned different ways to survive, and each reveals what the other traded away.

catalog.title: Zero Dark Thirty
catalog.description: An intelligence analyst pursues the trail to Osama bin Laden.
catalog.insight: Persistence gives Maya a source of authority even when bureaucratic caution makes others discount the same evidence.

catalog.title: Sicario
catalog.description: An FBI agent joins an operation that challenges her view of lawful force.
catalog.insight: Kate wants lawful procedure. Alejandro treats procedure as a tool, leaving them with conflicting ideas of professional duty.

catalog.title: Eye in the Sky
catalog.description: A military operation becomes a test of judgment as conditions change on the ground.
catalog.insight: Technical precision cannot settle the human stakes. Each link in the chain allocates responsibility differently.

catalog.title: Generation Kill
catalog.description: Marines advance into Iraq and confront the distance between orders and reality.
catalog.insight: Competence means reading what a situation demands and what orders actually permit. Humor keeps frustration from disrupting coordination.

catalog.title: The Outpost
catalog.description: Soldiers defend a remote outpost in Afghanistan.
catalog.insight: Shared routines and practical discipline become a form of trust when a remote assignment becomes a test of survival.

catalog.id: master and commander the far side of the world
catalog.title: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
catalog.description: A naval captain pursues a stronger ship while managing the cost to his crew.
catalog.insight: Aubrey's tactical confidence has to coexist with responsibility for his men. Maturin's independent judgment gives that duty a counterweight.

catalog.title: Michael Clayton
catalog.description: A law firm fixer discovers how far a powerful client will go.
catalog.insight: A fixer knows which rules institutions actually follow. A crisis forces him to decide what his competence is for.

catalog.title: Margin Call
catalog.description: A trading firm confronts a discovery that could bring it down overnight.
catalog.insight: A technical discovery gives the juniors knowledge, while the seniors retain the authority to distribute the cost.

catalog.title: The Insider
catalog.description: A whistleblower and a producer face institutional pressure over a tobacco investigation.
catalog.insight: Two professionals must defend a difficult truth while employers and allies calculate risk.

catalog.title: A Most Violent Year
catalog.description: A business owner faces escalating pressure as he tries to expand.
catalog.insight: He builds power through restraint and negotiation, then faces escalating pressure to abandon that restraint.

catalog.title: The Wire
catalog.description: An investigation follows the institutions that shape crime in Baltimore.
catalog.lead: McNulty, Stringer Bell and the ensemble
catalog.insight: Smart people gain local advantages, yet their roles and incentives limit how far they can alter the system.

catalog.title: Gomorrah
catalog.description: Loyalties shift within a Naples crime organization.
catalog.lead: Ciro Di Marzio and Gennaro Savastano
catalog.insight: Ambition is expressed through shifting alliances and an increasingly narrow idea of who can be trusted.

catalog.title: Un prophète
catalog.description: A young prisoner learns to survive and gain influence in prison.
catalog.insight: A vulnerable outsider builds power by observing groups, learning languages, and trading favors.

catalog.title: Heat
catalog.description: A detective and a disciplined thief recognize their similarities while trying to outmaneuver each other.
catalog.insight: Both men put craft above attachment. Each recognizes that the other's discipline has a personal cost.

catalog.title: Prisoners
catalog.description: A missing-child case drives a father and detective toward different choices.
catalog.insight: One man treats uncertainty as an emergency. The other must preserve method while feeling the same pressure to act.

catalog.title: Memories of Murder
catalog.description: Two detectives pursue a case that exposes the limits of their methods.
catalog.insight: The detectives trust different methods. The case forces both to confront the limits of certainty.

catalog.title: The Secret in Their Eyes
catalog.description: A retired investigator reopens a case that has shaped his life.
catalog.insight: Memory blurs the line between solving the old case and confronting decisions he avoided in his own life.

catalog.title: Khosla Ka Ghosla!
catalog.description: A family devises a scheme to reclaim a plot of land.
catalog.lead: Kamal Kishore Khosla and his family
catalog.insight: An honest man's predicament lets his family improvise around a system that gives them few formal options.

catalog.title: The Holdovers
catalog.description: A teacher, a student, and a cook spend the holidays at a near-empty boarding school.
catalog.lead: Paul Hunham, Angus Tully and Mary Lamb
catalog.insight: Each arrives with a reason to keep others at arm's length. Small acts of care let them recognize shared pain.

catalog.title: Perfect Days
catalog.description: A quiet routine in Tokyo reveals the details of one man's inner life.
catalog.insight: Routine is a deliberate choice. Small disruptions show both the value and the limits of the life he has made.

catalog.title: Paterson
catalog.description: A bus driver writes poetry amid the small rhythms of daily life.
catalog.insight: He attends to daily details and treats art as a practice. His relationship shapes how he meets loss.

catalog.title: The Big Sick
catalog.description: An unexpected illness brings a comedian closer to his ex-partner's family.
catalog.insight: Romance and family duty challenge Kumail's tendency to avoid difficult conversations.

catalog.title: Before Sunrise
catalog.description: Two strangers spend a night talking in Vienna.
catalog.insight: Conversation reveals how two strangers test vulnerability without knowing whether they will meet again.

catalog.title: Columbus
catalog.description: Two strangers bond over architecture and the family duties that keep them in town.
catalog.insight: Architecture provides a language for two people who feel stuck between care and independence.

catalog.title: Past Lives
catalog.description: Childhood friends reunite as adults and consider the lives they might have lived.
catalog.insight: Each person makes room for a different version of the same history without reducing anyone to an obstacle.

catalog.title: Coherence
catalog.description: A dinner party unravels when a comet passes overhead.
catalog.insight: An impossible event makes the guests test one another's reliability and reconsider who they are willing to protect.

catalog.title: Primer
catalog.description: Two engineers try to manage the consequences of an unexpected invention.
catalog.insight: Technical skill expands their options before either man understands the cost of secrecy and control.

catalog.title: Ex Machina
catalog.description: A programmer realizes his test of an artificial intelligence has a second agenda.
catalog.insight: Each interprets the others under unequal access to evidence, power and freedom.

catalog.title: Moon
catalog.description: A worker nearing the end of a lunar assignment discovers a problem with his isolation.
catalog.insight: The protagonist follows a contradiction in his routine and must reconsider what loyalty to his employer means.

catalog.title: Gattaca
catalog.description: A man borrows an identity to pursue a career in space.
catalog.insight: A methodical outsider uses discipline to challenge a system that treats a prediction as fate.

catalog.title: The Man from Earth
catalog.description: A farewell gathering turns into a debate about an extraordinary claim.
catalog.insight: Conversation forces each colleague to confront a different cost of taking an improbable claim seriously.

catalog.title: Devs
catalog.description: An engineer investigates the secret project run by her employer.
catalog.insight: Lily's investigation turns an intellectual question about agency into a personal decision about what she can do.

catalog.title: Severance
catalog.description: Employees discover what their company hides behind a division between work and private memory.
catalog.insight: The separation between work and private memory lets different versions of a person respond differently to the same institution.

catalog.title: The Death of Stalin
catalog.description: Officials scramble for power after Stalin dies.
catalog.insight: The officials use small signals to guess shifting power because a wrong reading carries immediate consequences.

catalog.title: The Last Duel
catalog.description: Three accounts of the same events show how a medieval institution protects power.
catalog.insight: Her account exposes how status and self-justification distort the same events when other people describe them.

catalog.title: A Separation
catalog.description: A private dispute between families becomes a legal and moral conflict.
catalog.insight: Competing family, religious and legal obligations make sensible choices harmful to someone else.

catalog.title: 12 Angry Men
catalog.description: A juror pushes eleven others to examine what they think they know.
catalog.insight: He uses questions and patience to make a group reconsider the difference between confidence and evidence.

catalog.title: Leave No Trace
catalog.description: A father and daughter living outside the system face different ideas of what each needs.
catalog.insight: Will expresses care by teaching self-reliance. Tom's growing sympathy for other ways of living turns their bond into a negotiation about independence.

catalog.title: The Station Agent
catalog.description: A man seeking solitude forms unexpected friendships after moving to an abandoned station.
catalog.insight: The characters earn one another's trust through small exchanges. Fin's reserve gives weight to the few times he chooses to reach out.

catalog.title: Short Term 12
catalog.description: A youth counselor's work forces her to deal with parts of her own past.
catalog.insight: Grace understands the young people because of her own history. Helping Jayden forces her to decide how to use knowledge she normally keeps private.

catalog.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
catalog.description: A foster child and a reluctant guardian rely on each other in the New Zealand bush.
catalog.insight: A child who expects rejection and an adult who values solitude make a bond through practical care and shared jokes.

catalog.title: The Straight Story
catalog.description: An older man travels slowly to see his estranged brother.
catalog.insight: Alvin acts on a family obligation in his own time. His encounters give him space to reveal regret without making a speech of it.
